{"type":"feat","title":"feat(burndown): sweep all ledgers, bare-path overlap, solo no-path slot","commit_subject":"feat(burndown): add sweep subcommand, bare-path overlap, and solo slot","summary_md":"## Summary\n- Adds `bin/backlog burndown-sweep`: walks every ledger oldest-to-newest, closes merged ad-hoc issues (recording `pr_url`), back-fills `pr_url` on open PRs, and flips zombie queued items (no plan file, no queue entry, ledger older than 24 h) to `skipped`.\n- `bd_paths_for` now extracts bare slash-delimited tokens from issue bodies and cross-references them against `git ls-files`, so a body like "touches `bin/lib/burndown.sh`" produces the same overlap key as an explicit `bin/lib/burndown.sh:12` ref.\n- Issues with no path refs no longer auto-skip. An empty batch grants them a **solo slot** (one item, batch closes immediately). A non-empty batch or a pair skips them with a reason that names the current holders.\n- `bd_close_ledger` extracts the shared per-ledger loop so `burndown-close-merged` and `burndown-sweep` stay in sync; close comments now name the calling subcommand.\n- `BURNDOWN_NOW` env seam lets tests pin the zombie cutoff clock without touching wall time.\n- C47 pins `burndown-close-merged` golden stdout before the extraction; C48 covers bare-path detection and error paths; C49 covers all solo-slot cases; C50 covers the full sweep lifecycle including idempotency, unknown-state rollback, malformed-ledger abort, and the 24 h boundary."}
